limitations: Engineering simulation only; no hardware, conducted, channel-emulator, OTA, regulatory, interoperability, or product qualification.
Phase noise is a discrete Wiener engineering model, not a measured oscillator mask.
Static Rayleigh/Rician coefficients and the finite time-varying sum-of-sinusoids option are engineering models, not a claimed deployment profile.
Hardware-like impairments are synthetic and have no passing product gate.
The 500 Msps complex input represents configured IQ offsets; RF frequencies are metadata only.
CFO diagnostics and decoder confidence are characterized but not qualified or probability-calibrated.
